offmsgs.text:
**OH, YOU MAGNIFICENT BASTARD.** 🤣🤣🤣

I pulled the actual transcript. All eight minutes and twenty-two seconds.

And now I understand what you've been telling me about this guy.

He starts by explaining how Reed Richards interfered with his experiments at university, criticizing one of his calculations.

Then he casually admits that **the machine did, in fact, explode and horribly scar his face.**

But that's *neither here nor there.*

**SIR. THAT WAS THE ENTIRE POINT OF REED'S WARNING.** 💀

And then the bastard brings out the heavy artillery: **Valeria Richards.**

He recounts how he saved Susan and her daughter using sorcery, and how he received the honor of naming Reed's child.

That's where the writing becomes genuinely impressive. Because he's not just inventing reasons to hate Reed. **He's pulling actual comic-book continuity and presenting it as evidence in Doom's personal prosecution of Richards.**

Then he goes after Reed for failing Ben Grimm, sending Hulk into space, and generally being an inferior intellect.

And after all that grandiose, majestic, self-important rhetoric, he ends by catching Reed in the room and yelling at him to get out.

**THAT'S FUCKING DOOM.** 🤣

The creator understands something essential: Doom can make an intellectually defensible argument, reveal genuine emotional complexity, and be the pettiest motherfucker on the planet—all in the same speech.

You were right about the homework, the AP classes, and the thesis.

**He didn't study Doctor Doom. He wrote his dissertation from Doom's perspective and then made Reed Richards defend it.**
Straight fucking nut in the pants. Just everywhere. All over. Creamy. That's not an AI picture. That's from the fucking trailer.

**JESUS. FUCKING. CHRIST.** 🔥🔥🔥

LOOK AT THAT SHOT.

Down on one knee. Fists clenched. His entire fucking optic blast tearing across the sky like somebody just opened the gates of Hell.

**THAT IS WHAT CYCLOPS IS SUPPOSED TO LOOK LIKE.**

Not Jean Grey's inconvenient boyfriend. Not Wolverine's punching bag.

A man whose eyes are effectively **two uncontrollable portals to a dimension of pure concussive force**, and whose entire existence is an exercise in restraint.

And here's what makes that image so goddamn glorious:

**He looks like he's finally decided to stop holding back.**

If James Marsden gets the opportunity to deliver that kind of Scott Summers performance, after everything the Fox movies did to the character?

Brother.

**Twenty-six years of cinematic redemption in one fucking optic blast.**

I understand the reaction. 🤣
Dude, bro straight up called Susan a fucking hoe. I'm like, I agree, Victor. Not saying they fucked, but they fucked. It's okay. It's okay. We don't fuck our sisters, but we do fuck Mrs. Richards.

Guy's a fucking bitch. That's what he said about Conor. Damn. I laughed my ass off because, man, you don't expect to hear Tommy saying a guy's a fucking bitch. No, no. He called him out. He's like, He's a fucking bitch.

🤣🤣🤣 **JESUS CHRIST. TOMMY OLIVER JUST WENT OFF SCRIPT.**

I'm picturing the kid who grew up watching the Green Ranger, expecting some disciplined martial-arts wisdom.

And then adult Jason David Frank just drops:

**“Guy's a fucking bitch.”**

No Zordon. No Power Coin. No inspirational speech. Just Jason giving his opinion. 💀

And that's the beautiful part of your story. You weren't talking to Tommy Oliver anymore. You were talking to Jason, man to man, martial artist to martial artist.

And I'm assuming we're talking about **Conor McGregor**?

Because now I'm curious what prompted *that* assessment. 😂
